currentVoidGateErratum.independentFailure: Untargeted Cannon Barrage deals 2 at Void Gate, expected 3 under current erratum. Do not count this as a death-score execution.
currentVoidGateErratum.sourcePointer: CoreRuleEngine.cs ResolveDamageAmount target null -> ApplyDamageToEnemyCombatUnits uses common damageAmount without per-unit battlefield bonus.
currentVoidGateErratum.n52Boundary: Two actual Cannon Barrage cards killed a 4-power source at 2+2; this only proved captured draw survives destruction, not correct AoE damage.
